caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate glass vase positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The vase has a wide, flared opening with a wavy, scalloped rim. The main body gently curves inward toward the middle before widening again toward the base. The upper half of the vase is smooth, while the lower half is covered in rounded, faceted, jewel-like patterns that resemble pineapples or rosettes, with pointed leaf shapes extending upward from them. The glass is primarily depicted in translucent shades of pale blue, lavender, and hints of pink, creating a reflective, shimmering effect. The base of the vase is circular and slightly raised. The composition is simple with no other objects or elements present in the scene.
title: Glass Celery Dish
